'''Dakron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was responsible for the [[Krikthasi Massacre]]. Dakron was killed during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was sent by [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] Agent [[Protarius]] to eliminate him.<ref name="TOR" />
